attributes.context: It appears in the Brick masons, Stonemasons and Tuck Pointers section, which states that the work includes making, preparing, tempering, and conveying materials whether done by hand or machine, and lists mixers, grout pumps, wheelbarrows, forklifts, boom winches, and tuskyhoists as included equipment.

extraction_text: all mechanical equipment replacing in whole or part the work of hod carriers shall be cleaned and operated by hod carriers
